T=$(ls -d /tmp/rpvaudit.* | head -1); W=$(cygpath -m $T); D="C:/Users/Георгий/.claude/plugins/cache/role-play-vibing/role-play-vibing/1.8.21/.claude/dispatcher"
UN=$(env | grep -E "^(RPV|ALPHA)_" | cut -d= -f1 | sed 's/^/-u /' | tr '\n' ' ')
cd $T; E() { env $UN CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$W" python "$@" 2>&1 | tail -${N:-5} | cut -c1-260; }
E "$D/tickets.py" --project "$W" new --owner researcher --title "p12" --desc "x" 
grep -E "^(status|next|updated|wait_for):" .claude/tickets/TK-003.md
# имитация потерянного хода: in_progress, без next, запись 3 дня назад
python - <<EOF
import re
p='.claude/tickets/TK-003.md'; s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
s=re.sub(r'^status:.*$','status: in_progress',s,flags=re.M); s=re.sub(r'^updated:.*$','updated: 2026-10-06T10:00:00+04:00',s,flags=re.M)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='').write(s)
EOF
E "$D/watch.py" --project "$W" --once; echo ---; grep -c . .claude/dispatcher/*.log 2>/dev/null | head; ls .claude/dispatcher; tail -3 .claude/dispatcher/ceo-inbox.md 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-250

T=$(ls -d /tmp/rpvaudit.* | head -1); W=$(cygpath -m $T); D="C:/Users/Георгий/.claude/plugins/cache/role-play-vibing/role-play-vibing/1.8.21/.claude/dispatcher"
UN=$(env | grep -E "^(RPV|ALPHA)_" | cut -d= -f1 | sed 's/^/-u /' | tr '\n' ' ')
cd $T; echo x > art.md
R() { role=$1; shift; env $UN CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$W" RPV_ROLE=$role python "$D/tickets.py" --project "$W" "$@" 2>&1 | tail -3 | cut -c1-250; grep -E "^(status|next):" .claude/tickets/TK-002.md | tr '\n' ' '; echo; }
echo "== A: TK-002 blocked; judge accept --path"; R judge result accept --path art.md --why "t" TK-002 2>&1
echo "== B: researcher blocked -> next"; R researcher result blocked --why "t2" TK-002
echo "== C: judge comment без next"; env $UN CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$W" RPV_ROLE=judge python "$D/tickets.py" --project "$W" comment TK-002 --author judge --text "c" | tail -2; grep -E "^(status|next):" .claude/tickets/TK-002.md | tr '\n' ' '
